```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
url = "https://www.statlearning.com/s/Credit.csv"
Credit = read.csv((url))
head(Credit)
credit_full_lm = lm(Balance~., data = Credit)
summary(Credit)
```


### Backward selection feature selection
```{r}
credit_reduced = update(credit_full_lm, .~. -Education-Region-Married-Own)
summary(credit_reduced)
```

### Forward selection
```{r}
library(broom)
summary_reduced = tidy(credit_reduced)
summary_reduced$p.values

```
